caption: The drawing depicts two metallic objects on a plain off-white or light beige background. The upper object is intricate, shaped somewhat like a paddle or leaf, with a central cut-out design featuring the numbers "1894" crafted from the metal itself and surrounded by an oval with regularly spaced notches or holes along its edge. Attached to the right end of this form is a handle that terminates in a rounded loop with a small ball detail. The lower object in the drawing is linear and angular, appearing like a flat bar with a right-angle bend on the left side and a subtle step or bend on the right side, almost like a specialized key or tool. Both objects are rendered in shades of brown or bronze, suggesting a metallic composition. In the lower right quadrant of the drawing, the artist's name, "William R. Ludwig," is printed or signed in small, neat script. The drawing is bordered by visible triangular paper or tape corners at the extreme top left, top right, and bottom left, which may be holding the paper in place.
title: Trivet
